svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.title: Styloma architecture diagram
svg.desc: A top-down flow diagram. External systems sit at the top and connect downward through a central gateway row into a row of backend services. On the left side, a vertical stack of databases connects those services downward to a wide horizontal bus that spans the full diagram. Below the bus, worker services spread across the bottom.
